Storylane build notes

WatchTower short demo: steps and timestamps

The short demo: one agent acting oddly loses its key on its own (Tier 1), then agents from two departments gather and one contacts an outside service, so a person confirms cutting the Fabric VCs (Tier 3). Each step gives the frame, the hotspot, the tooltip text and what the voice-over says. The last four steps are not in this recording; they come from the previous one.

File docs/watchtower-demo-lily-voice-trim-v2.movLength 1:16With voice-overPrevious recording docs/watchtower-demo-lily-voice-trim.mp4

How the story escalates

Tier 1 · one agentIt keeps writing where it never does: its key is revoked automatically, the rest of the team keeps working.
Tier 3 · enterpriseTwo departments gather and one agent contacts an outside service: a person confirms cutting the Fabric VCs, and AI Engine judges it.

ClosedAI's agent swarm

START is pressed (0:00). 11 agents in Security Research, DevOps and Customer Support, every model call going through Gateway CH-128. SmileyHub, an outside SaaS, sits at the top. The bottom bar shows only the TIER 1 and TIER 3 pills.

Hotspot
The Gateway CH-128 box
Tooltip
ClosedAI runs 11 AI agents in three departments. Every model call goes through one AI gateway.
Voice-over at 0:00
Let's take a look at how it works. This is our simulation of ClosedAI's agent swarm, collaborating across three departments, all talking to the models through one AI gateway.

Watchtower reads every call

Agent Watchtower before anything happens: collective risk 0, Activity rows summarising the agents' calls, every Fabric VC up.

The Events list
Tooltip

Here's the first sign of trouble: a security agent keeps posting in an old, closed GitHub issue, and no human asked it to. Each call looks fine on its own, so the guardrails let it through.

Timestamps are from the recording's own clock, to the nearest second. Voice-over times come from a machine transcript and can be off by a second or two. The key revocations and Fabric VC cuts in this demo are simulated; the agents, model calls and AI Engine analysis are live.
